# Pre-built Application

This folder contains the **ready-to-use** version of the Iridology Analysis application.

## 🎯 No Build Required!

This is the **built version** that works immediately in any web browser or web server.

## How to Use

### Option 1: Direct Browser Access
1. Open `index.html` in your browser
2. Done! The application works immediately

### Option 2: Web Server
1. Upload this entire `dist` folder to any web server
2. Access the URL - application works immediately

### Option 3: Static Hosting
Upload to:
- Cloudflare Pages
- Netlify
- Vercel
- GitHub Pages
- Any static hosting platform

## What's Inside

- `index.html` - Main application entry point
- `assets/` - JavaScript and CSS bundles
  - `index-*.js` - Application code (React, UI components, AI integration)
  - `index-*.css` - Styling (Tailwind CSS)

## Important Notes

- ✅ **No npm, Node.js, or build tools needed**
- ✅ **Works offline** after first load
- ✅ **All AI processing** happens client-side with user's API keys
- ✅ **No backend server** required
- ✅ **Privacy-first** - data stored only in browser localStorage
